messages.body: vamos achar uma maneira visual de adicionar pessoas. vamos brincar com os cards que utilizamos na aba "people". quero algo bonito e interativo. Talvez um stack de cartas. Quem cria um time sempre nomeia o Team Owner primenro. Team Managers vem depois então eles podem ficar fora desse fluxo.

Done in the new _teams/OwnerDeck.vue: the form now asks only for the Team Owner, as a hand of small People-tab cards. They rest in a pile that fans out on hover or focus; picking a card flies it into the Team Owner seat (picking another swaps them, the x sends it back). The last card, Someone else, flips over into an email field, and the invited person is seated as a card. Team Managers left the form and are added later from the Team.

Replaced the hand of cards with the card picker settled in Figma (new _teams/OwnerPicker.vue). One card, Add someone, opens a list of the Organization's people with a search that also takes an email (Invite for someone not in the Organization yet). Choosing closes the list and the person's card takes Add's place; removing it with the x brings Add back, since a Team has one Team Owner.
